title: What the Sand Cat knows

is_this_you.pressure: Cornered, you say one plain sentence and then go somewhere far. You remember that sentence for years.
is_this_you.love: You want open ground for yourself and a fixed address for them. You have noticed the unfairness. You keep both.
is_this_you.cost: Friends hear about your worst month from someone else, after the sand has already covered it.

opener.text: At Heliopolis, by the persea tree, the sun god Re took the shape of a great tomcat and killed the snake of evil [ucl-cat]. Book of the Dead vignettes paint the scene [ucl-cat]. In one account the serpent is Apophis, chaos itself, and Ra beats it as a cat [wiki-apep]. You were born in the Snake's year and carry a cat's name. You know both sides of that night.

howto: Three parts. Take them at your own pace.

tabs.label: The wanderer
tabs.intro: Two fires. One burns in the open. One burns under sand.

rows.text: Sagittarius is mutable Fire, ruled by Jupiter [wiki-sag]. It is frank, restless, and hates a fence [cafe-sag]. The Snake is yin Fire, composed and strategic, slow to trust [wiki-snake] [tcg-snake]. So the fire is doubled. One half wants the horizon. The other half would rather nobody knew which one.

rows.k: The sand cat does it too
rows.text: The sand cat is the only cat that lives only in deserts [nzoo]. It rests in a burrow by day and hunts at night [wiki-sandcat]. Recorded home ranges run from 13 to 35 square kilometres [wiki-sandcat]. Big ground. One cat. You know how that feels.

tabs.label: What you hunt
tabs.intro: Small game, long patience, one clean move.

rows.text: Its ears sit low and catch prey moving under the sand [wiki-sandcat]. Its ear canal is about twice the size of a house cat's [wiki-sandcat]. You hear the trouble before it surfaces. Then you say nothing until you are sure.

The sand cat takes venomous snakes, horned vipers among them [wiki-sandcat] [adw]. The archer of Sagittarius is said never to miss [wiki-sag]. The Snake waits for its moment [tcg-snake]. You are calm around danger. You wait, and then you move once.
The sand cat gets nearly all its water from what it catches, and can go months without drinking [nzoo]. You live on less than people guess. Keep the reserve. Spend it once, on freedom.

The Snake guides list crisis management [tcg-snake]. Add the archer's range and fieldwork fits, along with investigation and remote postings. You do best judged on what you bring back, never on how often you were seen.

tabs.label: Who crosses the dunes with you
tabs.intro: Three who keep pace at night. One who will not.
tabs.love_lead: The Snake is slow to fall and loyal once it has [tcg-snake]. You need someone who gives you range and leaves the burrow the way you dug it. The old pairings name three.

easy.why: The Sunset Moth (Leo, Rooster year) shares your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster, and Leo is Fire like you [wiki-cz] [wiki-trip].
The Sun Bear (Aries, Ox year) is trine kin, and Aries makes the third Fire sign [wiki-cz] [wiki-trip].
The Regal Jumping Spider (Leo, Monkey year) is your secret friend, though Snake and Monkey also share the 寅巳申 (yín sì shēn) penalty, so expect friction under the warmth [wiki-cz] [msc-penalty].

hard.why: The Cacomistle (Gemini, Pig year) is opposed to you twice, since the Pig clashes with your Snake and Gemini faces Sagittarius across the sky [wiki-cz] [wiki-aspect].

story.text: In Chinese, 猫 (māo), cat, sounds like 耄 (mào), old age [cma-maodie]. Paint a cat beside a butterfly and the picture says 耄耋 (màodié), a wish to live into your eighties [cma-maodie]. In 1788 Min Zhen painted one for a friend [cma-maodie].

closing: Carry your own water. The horizon will still be there at dawn.
